The claim explicitly mentions this behavior ('treated as empty') which aligns with the logic that faces are generated when the neighbor is 0. Since the code generates faces for neighbors that are 0, and boundary neighbors are effectively 0 (outside the defined chunk data), the evidence supports the claim that these faces are visible.
